name: Vista Global Holding Limited
note: Dubai-headquartered private aviation group: Vista Global Holding Limited ('Vista'), whose services are offered through its leading brands, including VistaJet and XO (its own release). A USD 600m minority investment led by RRJ Capital (with Andalusian Private Capital) was agreed in March 2025; founder and chairman Thomas Flohr remains the majority owner (ch-aviation, 2025-03-19).
